title_zh: 约好债务咨询前的材料梳理

scenario.label_zh: 约好债务咨询前的材料梳理
scenario.goal_zh: 说明债务手续造成的负担，并约定先与支持人员整理咨询材料而不代替专业判断

context_zh: 虚构债务咨询服务电话场景中，接待员帮助来访者安排材料整理，不提供财务或法律建议。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: I need advice about bankruptcy, but the forms are becoming a burden. I don't know which papers to bring.

sentences.speaker: Salma
sentences.text: Our adviser can discuss the options with you. Would a separate session to organize your paperwork help first?

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: Yes. I get lost in the bureaucracy before I even reach the person who can answer my questions.

sentences.speaker: Salma
sentences.text: A support worker has a slot on Monday at ten. They'll go through the document checklist, not recommend a financial decision.

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: Please book that. I'd like to sort the papers before the advice appointment.

sentences.speaker: Salma
sentences.text: I've booked the preparation session for Monday at ten. I'll send the checklist, and the adviser will handle the questions about your options later.
